summary: Highly organized and detail-oriented Staff Assistant with more than 14 years of experience supplying thorough, organized administrative support to 10+ senior executives.

experience.title: Staff Assistant
responsibilities: Provide administrative support to the Office of Information Technology and CISO.
Manage calendaring and scheduling across multiple systems (dCal, Lotus Notes, shared calendars).
Screen and triage telephone calls, interview callers, and route inquiries.
Prepare materials, travel arrangements, expense summaries, and reconciliations.
Take minutes at meetings and coordinate staff leave reports.
Process procurement card receipts in PARIS and liaise with vendors.
Support audio/visual conferences, train users, and operate A/V equipment.
Order and manage office, conference room, and break room supplies.
Cover reception duties, including handling mail, visitors, and scheduling.
Organize and maintain departmental files and documents.

experience.title: Receptionist
responsibilities: Answer and direct incoming calls, disburse parking passes and visitor badges.
Greet visitors, accept packages, and maintain telephone directory.
Provide support to Staff Assistants and manage mail distribution.

experience.title: Deputy Clerk
responsibilities: File and maintain court documents, including warrants and garnishments.
Collect court fines and costs, perform data entry at 70 WPM.
Provide courtroom support to the judge and manage court system communications.

experience.title: Legal Secretary
responsibilities: Prepare court motions and orders, handle billing and accounting.
Communicate extensively with courts and law offices.
Manage incoming/outgoing calls, greet visitors, and obtain signatures on financial documents.
